latestVersion.changelog:
free-image-editing 1.0.0 — First Release

- Instantly edit images and export to video by describing your edits (e.g., remove background, adjust brightness, add text overlay).
- Supports uploads of JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, and video/audio files up to 200MB.
- Simple, session-based workflow—no software to install; all processing runs server-side.
- Credit system: start with free 7-day tokens; check balance and usage in chat.
- Cloud-based export pipeline delivers 1080p MP4s in 20–40 seconds for typical tasks.
- Designed for creators needing quick, shareable edits for social media without a learning curve.
